```{r}
# --- 1. Cargar y limpiar ---
data = read.csv("data/clean_enmt_unam.csv", stringsAsFactors = FALSE)

data$ing_fam[data$ing_fam == 0] = NA          
data$p1a_12[data$p1a_12 %in% c(8, 9)] = NA    
```

```{r}
data = data[, c("Tam_loc", "ing_fam", "p1a_12")]
data = na.omit(data)
```

```{r}
# --- 2. Discretizar ing_fam en cuartiles ---
cortes = quantile(data$ing_fam, probs = seq(0, 1, 0.25))
cortes[1] = -Inf; cortes[length(cortes)] = Inf   # que Q1 y Q4 cubran los extremos

data$ing_fam_q = cut(data$ing_fam, breaks = unique(cortes),
                      labels = paste0("Q", 1:(length(unique(cortes)) - 1)),
                      include.lowest = TRUE)

table(data$ing_fam_q)   # revisar que quedaron ~balanceados
```

```{r}
# --- 3. Recodificar p1a_12 y Tam_loc como factor ---
data$p1a_12 = factor(data$p1a_12, levels = 1:3,
                      labels = c("Cotidiano", "Ocasional", "Nunca"))
data$Tam_loc = factor(data$Tam_loc, levels = 1:4,
                       labels = c("100k+", "15k-99999", "2500-14999", "1-2499"))

data = data[, c("Tam_loc", "ing_fam_q", "p1a_12")]
str(data)
```
```{r}
library(bnlearn)

# --- 4. dag_jf reducido: mismo espíritu que arc_set, solo 3 nodos ---
dag_q = empty.graph(nodes = c("Tam_loc", "ing_fam_q", "p1a_12"))

arc_set_q = matrix(c("Tam_loc",  "ing_fam_q",
                      "Tam_loc",  "p1a_12",
                      "ing_fam_q","p1a_12"),
                    byrow = TRUE, ncol = 2,
                    dimnames = list(NULL, c("from", "to")))

arcs(dag_q) = arc_set_q
graphviz.plot(dag_q, shape = "ellipse")

bn_q = bn.fit(dag_q, data = data, method = "bayes")
```
```{r}
# --- 5. La consulta: P(ing_fam_q = Qi, p1a_12 = "Cotidiano" | Tam_loc = t) ---
set.seed(42)

niveles_tam  = levels(data$Tam_loc)
niveles_ing  = levels(data$ing_fam_q)

resultado = expand.grid(Tam_loc = niveles_tam, ing_fam_q = niveles_ing)
resultado$prob = NA

for (i in seq_len(nrow(resultado))) {
  t  = as.character(resultado$Tam_loc[i])
  qi = as.character(resultado$ing_fam_q[i])

  resultado$prob[i] = cpquery(
    bn_q,
    event    = (ing_fam_q == qi & p1a_12 == "Cotidiano"),
    evidence = list(Tam_loc = t),
    method   = "lw", n = 10^5
  )
}

# tabla Tam_loc x cuartil de ingreso, cada celda = P(Q_i, Cotidiano | Tam_loc)
tabla = xtabs(prob ~ Tam_loc + ing_fam_q, data = resultado)
round(tabla, 3)
```
